Study on the remunaration of the European Electronic Toll Service (EETS) Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority's intention to publish a future middle value procedure.

The tenderer must prove experience in the field of EETS systems and schemes. The tenderer must prove experience in the GNSS and DSRC tolling systems. The tenderer must prove having at its disposal the following profiles: Higher education degree and at least 1 year’s experience in the field of cost accounting related to tolling systems.
